page.answer: Short answer. The best portable Apple CarPlay screen with a backup camera in 2026 is the Carpuride C98 With Backup Camera ($149.99). Buy a model that ships with the camera: the same 9-inch screen without one is $129.99, and Carpuride's $30 spare cameras fit one model only.

page.after:
What the differences mean

  • The camera adds $20 to $30. C98: $149.99 − $129.99 = $20. C92: $189.99 − $169.99 = $20. W903: $249.99 − $219.99 = $30.
  • Adding the camera later costs more. Plain C98 plus Carpuride's spare camera: $129.99 + $30 = $159.99, which is $10 more than the bundle, and you have to pick the right camera variant yourself.
  • Price per inch of screen, camera included. HIEHA: $59.99 ÷ 7 = $8.57/in. C98: $149.99 ÷ 9 = $16.67/in. C92: $189.99 ÷ 9.3 = $20.43/in. W903 dual: $249.99 ÷ 9.3 = $26.88/in.
  • Power at the screen. The C98 lists 'Type-C 5V 2.5A': 5 V × 2.5 A = 12.5 W, fed through the lighter adapter.
  • Cable reach. Carpuride's car extension cable is 9 m: 9 × 3.281 = 29.5 ft.

Freedom to fit any standard RCA reversing cameraAn in-dash unit such as the Carpuride YT09S ($259.99), not a portable screen

Why the camera has to come in the box

A portable CarPlay screen's camera port is not a universal input. Carpuride sells its $30 rear camera per screen and tells buyers to 'select the corresponding model based on your device'. If you're unsure, it asks you to email support with the 'machine version number (which can be found in the settings menu of the machine)'. Its extension cables are also tied to the screen: 'Camera extension cables are not universal across different models.' Its WF01 wireless rear camera 'cannot be used with Carpuride W903, W905, W904, W703, C92, C98, W901 Plus and W701 Plus'.

Other brands split the same way. ESSGOO's own standalone reversing camera is a 720×480 NTSC camera with an 'AV-In' interface. Lamtto, which also makes portable screens, says plainly: 'Only original or compatible cameras are supported.' Carpuride's YT09S double-DIN in-dash stereo is the exception. Its page says it 'Supports RCA AV connector type rear view camera signal input, automatically switching to parking image when reversing gear engaged.'

A screen switches to the rear view only when it gets a reverse signal. Lamtto's install guide runs the camera's red trigger wire to the reverse light's positive terminal, because 'the reverse light only activates when the car is in reverse gear'. If the rear view stays on all the time, Lamtto names the cause as 'Incorrect wiring of the reverse trigger wire'. Plan for this splice at the back of the car whichever kit you buy.

Not recommended

Carpuride W903 with Front Camera ($219.99) if you want a backup camera. It has only the 4K front dash cam, and the WF01 wireless rear camera is listed as incompatible with the W903. The same applies to the plain C98, C92 and V92R listings and to the ESSGOO TS0001, none of which lists a rear camera in the box.
